title: Interop: cross-check room-policy with Phoenix and Haven
description: Not yet tested anywhere. Phoenix: phnx-im mimi-room-policy (July 2026; no license file — read-only use, fixtures need provenance). Haven: havenmessenger/interop room-policy code. Compare against mimid's mimi-room-policy (room-policy-04): decode their encodings -> compare -> re-encode byte-identical, and the reverse; note which room-policy revision each targets. Harness under tools/interop/{phoenix,haven} (decision .46.4). Findings to their trackers or the WG with Mark's OK. Before the IETF 127 hackathon if feasible.
